cards.subject: Mashan'she
lines: The zone's real name is Mashan'she — Loom of the Earth Mother. It was fertile grassland and tauren lived on it.
Desolace is what the survivors called it afterwards.

cards.subject: It is supposed to look like this
lines: Black stormy sky, dead trees, yellow polluted pools, bone litter, no green anywhere.
It is a zone whose entire premise is that something ate the life out of it.
Cataclysm made it fertile — grass, trees, settlements. What you are standing in no longer exists in the live game.

cards.subject: The rite that woke the wrong thing
lines: Tauren shamans performed a ceremony here to wake the Earth Mother. What they woke was Princess Theradras, daughter of the Stonemother.
Newly awake and starving, she reached out to the surroundings for sustenance and consumed their energies.
All of this grey is what she left.

cards.subject: Zaetar
lines: He came to investigate the dying land and fell in love with Theradras instead. He knew it was against nature and did it anyway.
Their children were the centaur. Seeing disgust in their father's face, they murdered him.
Theradras entombed his spirit in Maraudon, and the centaur hold it as holy ground.

cards.subject: The clans are brothers
lines: Zaetar and Theradras produced five khans, and the centaur tribes are named for them.
The Gelkis and the Magram tearing each other apart across southern Desolace are two of those brothers.
The whole race is one family, still fighting over the corpse of its father.

cards.subject: You have to choose
lines: One of very few directly opposed reputations in the whole game: killing one raises the other and lowers the first.
Each side has its own chain and its own gear at the end. You cannot be liked by both.
Whichever you pick, the other village is permanently hostile ground.

cards.subject: The Kodo Graveyard
lines: The kodo of Kalimdor walk to one specific patch of northern Desolace to die.
"No one knows why the kodo beasts come to this particular place, but it is a habit long maintained."
It is an elephants' graveyard, and that is the only explanation anyone has.

cards.subject: Some of the bones are too big
lines: Several skeletons out there are larger than any kodo alive in the game.
Whatever was dying here was dying here long before anything you can currently kill.
Grave Moss grows in the ribcages.

cards.subject: Smeed Scrabblescrew
lines: He has a device called the Kodo Kombobulator that jolts an ancient or aged kodo into a tamed one that follows you home.
He is intercepting animals on their way to die and selling them to caravan owners.
"Three, excellent... I am going to be rich... yes, very rich!"

cards.subject: Thunder Axe Fortress
cards.tag: The Burning Blade, in the northwest
lines: They hold the Hand of Iruxos, which opens demon portals, and a Sceptre of Light they took off the naga.
They have worked out how to summon Nazargen.
The Mannoroc Coven is down the road to the south.

cards.subject: Patch 1.4.0 gave the fires names
lines: "Fires in Thunder Axe Fortress in Desolace now have proper names."
For the game's first months, the campfires of a demon cult were nameless objects.
Somebody filed that.

cards.subject: Maraudon
lines: Three wings: Wicked Grotto, Foulspore Cavern, Earth Song Falls.
It is two places overlaid — the centaur's ancestral burial ground, and a primal temple of elemental earth.
The last thing in it is Theradras herself, still sitting on her husband.

cards.subject: Killing her frees him
lines: Beat Theradras and Zaetar's spirit is released from the stone.
He chooses to remain in Maraudon regardless, to watch over the children who killed him.
